data.name: Private Tour: Boston's LGBTQ Past
data.headline: Learn about Boston’s flourishing gay and lesbian culture on a private guided walking tour
data.description:
Travel in the footsteps of Boston’s 19th and 20th century gay and lesbian friends.

Explore Ralph Waldo Emerson and Walt Whitman's walks along the Common; Charlotte Cushman’s cross-dressing roles; World War II bars and baths; and the AIDS memorial quilt project. Learn about Boston’s flourishing gay and lesbian culture on this guided walking tour.

This tour is presented in partnership with The History Project, a nonprofit organization that documents, preserves and shares New England's LGBTQ history.

*From April to mid-November, Private tours of the 90min Boston's LGBTQ Past walking tour are bookable online for groups of up to 20 people with at least 2 weeks notice. To request a private tour for groups of more than 20 people, or in the fall/winter, please use the Private Tour Request form. Please provide at least 2 weeks notice in advance of your preferred tour date for larger groups or special requests.* [Private tour request form link](https://form.jotform.com/220595239082054)

data.cancellation_notes:
- Please arrive at least 10 minutes early to meet your guide. Late admittance is not guaranteed. 
- Public tours can be rebooked on another available tour, or canceled for full credit as a gift card, with at least 24hrs notice. Customers can conveniently cancel or rebook public tour registrations using the "change booking" and "cancel booking" links in the confirmation and reminder emails. Cancellations less than 24hrs prior to the tour start or no shows cannot be credited.
- Private tours can be canceled up to 4 days before the start for a full refund. Private tour cancellations made within 4 days of the tour date incur a small cancellation fee, though they can be rebooked for no additional fees. Contact us to cancel or rebook a private tour. 
- All tours are held in all weather - rain or shine. Please be prepared for the weather and to walk and stand outdoors on your tour. In case of tour cancellation by Boston By Foot due to extreme weather or unforeseen circumstances, you will be offered a refund or exchange. If groups choose to cancel a tour due to weather, the above policy stands.
